name: dolls-lineup
purpose: M2 시안 한 장(결정 60 — 라운드마다 그림). 인형 열다섯이 한 줄로 선 그림 — out/kit/characters.json 의 몸·색·부착물이 한 세계로 읽히는지, 같은 몸 셋(톰·제리 / 안젤·노라 / 다니엘·빅터)이 부착물로 갈리는지 눈으로 보는 용. 실물은 Kenney GLB + colormap 으로 개발이 렌더한다 — 이 그림은 참고이고 화면에 안 오른다. /design 스킬로 하네스가 뽑는다.
prompt: STYLE: the first attached image is the approved look (soft miniature diorama, matte clay/felt materials, warm morning light from the upper left, soft shadows, pastel beige and cream). The other attached images show the exact body type of the figures — Kenney 'mini characters' low-poly toys: round head, no neck, stubby arms and legs, flat-shaded, about 2 heads tall. Draw FIFTEEN such toy figures standing in ONE ROW on a plain beige ground plane (#d9d1bf), camera slightly above eye level and a little to the left (a gentle 3/4 view, not top-down), same scale for all, evenly spaced with one figure-width gap, the whole row filling a 21:9 frame. No buildings, no props on the ground, no text, no name tags, no UI, no border. Each figure wears a WHITE lower garment (#f4efe4) and a colored upper garment; hair and skin as listed. From LEFT to RIGHT: (1) BOSS — the tallest figure, navy top #2f4f7a with a thin gold belt #8a7320, black hair, medium skin #d9a878, wearing a black Korean GAT hat (a small cylinder crown on a wide flat round brim). (2) deep-teal top #1f5f4f, blond hair #d8b25c, light skin #f3d3b3, body with a small cap. (3) IDENTICAL body and blond hair to (2) but wine top #7a3b52 and round black GLASSES. (4) blue-violet top #4b5f9e with a thin plum sash #5b3a63, chestnut hair #8b5a2b, light skin. (5) a figure with a WHITE top and an orange SKIRT #c96f3b (the only one with a colored bottom), blond braided hair, light skin. (6) dark brown top #6b4a2f, black hair, medium skin. (7) moss-green top #4a5d3a, chestnut short hair with a headband, light skin. (8) teal top #2f6b7a, dark-brown long hair tied low #4a2c1a, medium skin. (9) brick-red top #9c3b2f, black hair, medium skin, slightly shorter body. (10) navy top #2f4f7a, black hair tied back, medium skin. (11) burnt-orange top #a8541f, dark-brown hair in a high bun #4a2c1a, light skin. (12) plum top #5b3a63, black short hair, dark skin #6e4630. (13) navy top #2f4f7a, black hair, medium skin, ARMS SPREAD WIDE (the only figure with open arms). (14) IDENTICAL body to (11) but burnt-orange top #a8541f, WHITE hair #a8a6ae, medium skin, holding a walking CANE. (15) IDENTICAL body to (12) but plum top #5b3a63, chestnut hair #8b5a2b, light skin, wearing black SUNGLASSES. Colors must be exactly these; no gradients, no patterns except the boss's belt. Soft rounded edges, matte surfaces, one warm key light, subtle ambient occlusion under the feet. Landscape 21:9, 2520x1080 PNG.
after: out/screens/dolls-lineup.png 로 저장, 팔레트 스냅 안 함(시안). 내가 보는 것 셋: ① 열다섯 실루엣이 전부 다른가 — 특히 (2)(3), (11)(14), (12)(15) 가 안경·지팡이·선글라스로 갈리나 ② 옷 색이 characters.json 표와 같은가(눈대중, 정확한 색은 colormap 이 낸다) ③ 첫 그림(seoul-toy-concept)과 같은 세계로 보이나(재질·빛). 셋 다 들면 M2 시안으로 manifest 에 적고, 아니면 프롬프트만 고쳐 한 번 더. 두 번 넘게 안 돌린다 — 실물은 렌더다.
status: 완료 — 하네스가 2026-09-13 21:35 에 뽑음. out/screens/dolls-lineup.png (1915x821, 21:9). 요청한 2520x1080 은 전체 해상도 내려받기가 막혀 인라인 판으로 대체.
